summary: fractal setup, run from an install laid out before the rename (st3 with st -> st3 and no fractal), now adds the fractal command beside st and st3 as a link to the same binary. Such an install kept st and st3 only, while both warn that they will be removed on 2026-11-16. An existing fractal is never touched

schema.detail: No table, file or schema change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint, retention or digest change.

compatibility.detail: Setup may now create ~/.local/bin/fractal -> st3 (or the same link beside the st on PATH) when only st and st3 exist there; st and st3 are unchanged.

manual.detail: Running fractal setup (or st setup) once on an older install adds the command; nothing else is needed.

recovery.detail: Removing the added fractal link restores the previous layout.
